name: fight15-s16
title: Autosave on every five minutes by default; the host's Recovery page promises held seats wait

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
wait_combo ComboHostScene Grasslands
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
activate ButtonLobbyOptions
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageRecovery
wait_ms 600
video_mark recovery-host
assert_label LabelHostRecReclaim Seats stay held until you give them away
assert_text_fits LabelHostRecReclaim
assert_no_overlap LabelHostRecRejoin LabelHostRecReclaim
assert_checked CheckHostRecAutosave 1
assert_label ComboHostRecAutosaveInterval 5 minutes
assert_text_fits ComboHostRecAutosaveInterval
assert_label LabelHostRecAutosaveHint Every 60 s to 60 min; 5 min by default
assert_text_fits LabelHostRecAutosaveHint
combo_select ComboHostRecAutosaveInterval 10 minutes
assert_label ComboHostRecAutosaveInterval 10 minutes
activate ButtonHostOptApply
wait_ms 900
video_mark recovery-applied-host
activate TabHostPageSeats
wait_ms 600
activate ButtonHostSeatDetails1
wait_ms 900
assert_visible HostSeatDialog 1
video_mark seat-words-host
assert_label ButtonHostSeatDlgWait Keep for Joiner
assert_label ButtonHostSeatDlgApprove Let someone join
assert_label ButtonHostSeatDlgCancel Cancel this approval
assert_text_fits ButtonHostSeatDlgWait
assert_text_fits ButtonHostSeatDlgApprove
assert_text_fits ButtonHostSeatDlgCancel
activate ButtonHostSeatDlgClose
wait_ms 600
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_substate Lobby 30
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/applied.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/scene-end.json 120
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/scene-end.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/applied.json 120
wait_ms 1200
activate ButtonLobbyEditSetup
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageRecovery
wait_ms 600
video_mark recovery-joiner
assert_checked CheckHostRecAutosave 1
assert_label ComboHostRecAutosaveInterval 10 minutes
assert_enabled ComboHostRecAutosaveInterval 0
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_substate Lobby 30
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/scene-end.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit

checklist.what: The host's Recovery page promises held seats wait for the host's word and starts on autosave every five minutes.
The joiner's Match details read the cadence the host applied, and cannot change it.
